auth.label: WIND_API_KEY
auth.description: The WIND_API_KEY used to access Wind financial data. Sign in with your phone number and copy the key from https://aifinmarket.wind.com.cn/#/user/overview.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call a current Wind financial data MCP tool with JSON arguments after checking its live schema with list_tools.

serverType.description: The Wind MCP service family that owns the requested tool.

toolName.description: The exact tool name returned by list_tools.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the inputSchema returned for the selected tool; serialized arguments must not exceed 1000000 bytes.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one current Wind MCP tool.

result.description: The tool result. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the Wind MCP tool.

top_k.description: The maximum number of relevant documents or excerpts to return; defaults to 5.

actions.name: get_fund_kline
actions.description: Get historical ETF or LOF K-line price data for an explicit date range and period.

windcode.description: The Wind security name or code.

begin_date.description: The inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: The inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

aftype.description: The adjustment type: 0 for forward adjustment or 1 for backward adjustment.

issusp.description: Whether to include suspended periods: 0 to exclude or 1 to include.

afdate.description: The optional adjustment base date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

inputSchema.description: Input for reading a security K-line series over an explicit date range.

result.description: The tool result. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the Wind MCP tool.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: Discover the current Wind financial data tools and their live input schemas for stocks, funds, indices, bonds, documents, economics, or analytics.

serverType.description: The Wind MCP service family that owns the requested tool.

inputSchema.description: The Wind MCP service whose tools should be discovered.

serverType.description: The Wind MCP service family that owns the requested tool.

name.description: The exact Wind MCP tool name to pass to call_tool.

description.description: The current tool description supplied by Wind MCP.

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.

readOnlyHint.description: Whether the tool is expected not to modify data.

destructiveHint.description: Whether the tool may perform destructive operations.

idempotentHint.description: Whether repeated calls with the same arguments are expected to be idempotent.

openWorldHint.description: Whether the tool may interact with entities outside Wind.

annotations.description: MCP behavior hints supplied by Wind.

inputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for the tool arguments, supplied by Wind MCP.

items.description: A tool currently exposed by one Wind MCP service.

tools.description: Tools currently exposed by the selected Wind MCP service.

outputSchema.description: The current tool catalog for one Wind MCP service.

beginDate.description: The inclusive data start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: The inclusive data end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

observation.description: A number of recent observations, or all for the complete series.

inputSchema.description: Input for searching or fetching Wind EDB economic indicators.

result.description: The tool result. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the Wind MCP tool.
